channel.title: Fixture Wire (fictional)
channel.description: Fictional fixture feed for Brief v2 tests

item.title: Northland and Southmark agree to talks on extending Vell Valley truce
item.description: negotiators from the two fictional states said they will meet next week to discuss turning the 30-day ceasefire into a longer deal.

item.title: Kestrel Robotics opens its first humanoid assembly line in Ohio
item.description: the fictional startup says the plant will build 200 humanoid robots a year and hire 300 people.

item.title: Tessera Semiconductor delays its 2 nm chip plant by six months
item.description: the fictional chipmaker blamed equipment shortages for pushing back its newest factory.

item.title: Drought-hardy wheat holds yields through a three-year field trial
item.description: researchers report the fictional variety kept 90% of normal yield in dry years.

item.title: Senate panel advances a fictional rail safety bill
item.description: the bill would require new brake sensors on freight cars carrying hazardous materials.

item.title: Stocks edge higher as bond yields dip
item.description: the main fictional index rose 0.4% as the 10-year yield slipped to its lowest in a month.

item.title: Alpine glaciers lost record ice this summer, survey finds
item.description: a fictional monitoring group says glaciers lost 4% of their volume in one season.

item.title: Ransomware attack disrupts Harbor Health billing systems
item.description: the fictional hospital group says patient care continues but bills and prescriptions are delayed.

item.title: Maravel opposition wins snap election in a landslide
item.description: the opposition alliance in the fictional island republic won two-thirds of seats.

item.title: Calloway dock workers vote on a new contract offer
item.description: the fictional union will count ballots tomorrow on a deal with a 9% raise over three years.

item.title: Riverside Rovers win their first league title in 40 years
item.description: the fictional club clinched the title with two games left.

item.title: Fictional coin doubles in a day
item.description: bad card, topic not in the vocabulary.

item.title: Vell Valley talks open as both sides pull back heavy guns
item.description: monitors confirmed artillery moved 20 km from the line as talks began in a neutral city.

item.title: White House issues guidance on AI tools in federal hiring
item.description: agencies must test AI screening tools for bias and tell applicants when they are used.

item.title: Qaldar and neighbors sign a water-sharing pact
item.description: the fictional states agreed to split river flows and build two desalination plants.

item.title: Port of Sanmar opens a new deepwater berth
item.description: the fictional port can now take the largest container ships, cutting transit times by two days.

item.title: Trial finds a cheap pill cuts migraine days by a third
item.description: a fictional 2,000-patient trial tested a generic blood pressure drug.

item.title: Pinecone patches a browser flaw used in targeted attacks
item.description: the fictional company urged users to update after spyware exploited the bug.

item.title: Tessera shares fall 9% after chip plant delay
item.description: investors cut forecasts after the fictional chipmaker pushed back its newest factory.

item.title: Calloway dock workers approve contract, ending strike
item.description: 71% voted yes; ships will start unloading tomorrow.

item.title: Two former Lumen researchers raise $25M for AI tutoring
item.description: the fictional startup will sell math tutoring to school districts.

item.title: Jury convicts former Brookhaven mayor of bribery
item.description: the fictional ex-mayor took payments from a towing contractor, prosecutors said.

item.title: Early voting opens in three special elections
item.description: voters in three fictional districts will fill House seats left vacant this summer.

item.title: Qaldar raises oil output by 200,000 barrels a day
item.description: repeat of an earlier card, no new development.
